text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following up on her Oka Sho victory with 
another win in the Oaks, Vivlos claims a 
double crown. The crowd's hopes for a 
Triple Tiara soar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for victory in the Shuka Sho, 
Vivlos asked her Trainer for another way 
to build confidence alongside the summer 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for even greater heights, Vivlos 
and her Trainer set their next sights on 
the Shion Stakes.
